content.comment_body: Is it possible to forward input signals from the [product_name] Communication Module to memory variables in the [product_name] Basis Module? I have a [product_name] Basis Module connected to a [product_name] Communication Module. My setup requires both 230V and 12V DC digital inputs. However, you can handle the signals differently. Instead of connecting your signal straight to an input on the [product_name] Communication Module, you can use a relay with two normally open contacts—one for the [product_name] Communication Module and one for the [product_name] Basis Module.
